notes.title: Officially announcing our sweetest creation — High Times! 🍩
notes.content:
Hey gang,

We're super excited to publicly unveil our latest and sweetest creation: [b]High Times[/b].

In a world where you can get high with no consequences, the hardest drug to get over are your exes. In this (anti) dating sim about drugs and donuts, you'll manage a café, serve special donuts that get customers high, and live out the ultimate fantasy — getting closure with your exes!

[b]Wishlist on Steam:[/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2251220]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2251220[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910603/db16936e5220834aa457fb733c1ae525916268c9.png[/img]

Welcome to The Hotbox!

It's the year 2069 (nice!), and miracles have been made in the name of science. The greatest of them all? Drugs are now totally safe to consume!

Set in the fictional world of San Mazo — [i]which is totally not a rip off of LA[/i] — you're a Mood Confectioner (a fancy term for someone who bakes drugs into sweets) who must turn your boss' café, The Hotbox, into the hottest place in town or get fired. That isn’t the end of your problems, though — the exes whom you've ghosted are back in town and they all have a bone to pick with you.

Good luck, heartbreaker!

[b]Game Genre:[/b] Simulation, Casual
[b]Story Genre:[/b] Comedy, Slice of Life, Drama, Romance
[b]Length:[/b] 8-10 hours, depending on reading speed (single playthrough)
[b]Platforms:[/b] PC (Steam); Mobile (iOS/Android); Consoles (Nintendo Switch)
[b]Languages:[/b] English, Simplified & Traditional Chinese (please stay tuned for more languages!)
[b]Intended Release:[/b] 2024

[h3]SCREENSHOTS[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910603/6f3dc36f674855d433181a30bd4ef4b0f49dd775.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910603/b89ce4bae0a88f2fb8cbcb7c31cfa3a983fbea90.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910603/99e451aeda549a0fe15ec28e48f1e47552b61964.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910603/98180ab43ce1fe12ec50e826521254f96b6dad01.png[/img]
[i]*For more screenshots, please visit the game's [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2251220]Steam page[/url].[/i]

[h3]FEATURES[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910603/a4812e99b67f344a02a85a1ebfe55feabb47b630.gif[/img]
[b]🍩 Customizable Main Character[/b]
Choose the face that broke many hearts for a more personal experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910603/b5370a3d2eec538661e59507f3ba7bd036b95524.gif[/img]
[b]🍩 Donut Baking Sim[/b]
Manage your own Mood Café and serve special donuts that get the high times rolling! Know your clients, find out their tastes, and make those donuts that they’ve been craving for!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910603/0df8f996dfef1480a1dcb1106270e6516280b352.gif[/img]
[b]🍩 Five Exes To Get Over[/b]
Surprise! Your exes are back to complicate things. They’ve got their own baggage, but you’re a Mood Confectioner, not a bellboy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910603/e57346d048ea21cfe3240e223e8f807e3354b6dc.gif[/img]
[b]🍩 A Quirky Cast of Characters[/b]
From a girl in a chicken suit to a walking Jojo reference, San Mazo is full of zany characters. Meet them all, serve their favorite donuts, and find out what makes them tick.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910603/4e0565e148a93d6b42aace5bbe58e0302609978d.gif[/img]
[b]🍩 English Voice Acting[/b]
A cast of professional English voice actors will be bringing the characters to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910603/316a95d45f07b4658283a50590304d48c3937909.gif[/img]
[b]🍩 Dynamic Comic Book-Styled Visuals[/b]
Watch your story come to life with animated comic book-styled panels and vibrant CGs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910603/236ea9f0ff9583e669daaca9676d0e2e1357bcfc.gif[/img]
[b]🍩 Multiple Endings[/b]
Will you get lost in a temporary high, leave things a hot mess, or find closure? Be sure to listen to your customers! You’re not just serving donuts; you’re serving advice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910603/4260ff1f537802c45c4972f91b28e7c6af184fab.gif[/img]
[b]🍩 Original Soundtrack[/b]
A blend of originally composed soundtracks that’ll make service time a time you can vibe to!

[h3]RELEVANT LINKS[/h3]

High Times's development is being funded through our [url=https://www.patreon.com/yangyangmobile]Patreon[/url]. If you'd like to support us, please consider subscribing!

More information will be revealed in the coming months along with a demo, so please don’t forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2251220]follow and add the game to your wishlist[/url] to get notified!

notes.title: Perfect Gold is out on Mobile & Nintendo Switch!
notes.content:
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FVY8lVdaQAAzxHq?format=jpg&name=medium[/img]

[b]SURPRISE![/b]

We're super excited to announce that Perfect Gold is now available on Google Play, Apple App Store & Nintendo Switch platforms! Just in time for pride month! 🌈 💛 

You can grab a copy of the game in the store links below:

🌻  Americas(Switch): [url=https://bit.ly/pg-us-switch]https://bit.ly/pg-us-switch[/url]
🌻  Europe (Switch): [url=https://bit.ly/pg-eu-switch]https://bit.ly/pg-eu-switch[/url]
🌻  Hong Kong (Switch): [url=https://bit.ly/pg-hk-switch]https://bit.ly/pg-hk-switch[/url]
🌻  Google Play: [url=https://bit.ly/pg-googleplay]https://bit.ly/pg-googleplay[/url]
🌻  Apple App Store: [url=https://apple.co/3Ql07od ]https://apple.co/3Ql07od [/url]

This game wouldn't be possible without the support of our beloved Patreon supporters & Kickstarter backers. It's been a blast working on this game with you all. We're thankful for the support and faith you've given us. We're happy that we were able to deliver! ːsimonewinkː🌻

[h2]Please try out the demo of our next game![/h2]

Before we go, we'd like to promote our upcoming game, a horror visual novel called "Saint Maker".

The story of Saint Maker is inspired by the shows "Haunting of Hill House" and "Midnight Mass". You play as Holly Beltran, a young girl who experiences strange hauntings while visiting an old convent. The game will be dealing with both psychological and religious horror, and features eerie statues of saints coming to life — their faces cracked and twisted.

If this is something up your alley, we have a short demo available over at our Steam page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1785300

We hope you give it a try and if you like it, please add the game to your wishlist! Thank you! 💛

notes.title: Our next game: Saint Maker!
notes.content:
Dear gang,

We'd like to officially announce our upcoming game, "[b]Saint Maker[/b]", a religious psychological horror visual novel.

[h3]ABOUT THE GAME[/h3]

While attending a religious recollection, Holly Beltran experiences strange hauntings throughout the convent. At night, broken faced statues and whispered prayers haunt Holly’s dreams — before the recollection is over, Holly may have to face more than her own demons to come out alive.

[list][*] [b]Length:[/b] 4-8 hours, depending on reading speed
[*] [b]Platforms:[/b] PC (Steam/Itch.io); Mobile (iOS/Android); Nintendo Switch
[*] [b]Intended Release:[/b] 2022[/list]

[previewyoutube=pcLijhOfBbI;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]FEATURES[/h3]

[b]✟ Religious/Psychological Horror:[/b] Experience a horror story rich with eerie religious iconography and psychological scares.

[b]✟ Fully Voiced:[/b] A full cast of professional English voice actors will be bringing the characters to life.

[b]✟ Interactive Dialogue Choices:[/b] As the horror unfolds, your choices will help Holly discover more about herself during this ordeal.

[b]✟ Bone-chilling Visuals:[/b] Witness the haunting setting of the Convent of the Sisters of Saint Idelora, with detailed backgrounds, CGs, and animated illustrations adding to an immersive and terrifying experience.

[b]✟ Original Soundtrack:[/b] Originally composed soundtracks which add both horror and heart to the story.

[b]PLEASE ADD SAINT MAKER TO YOUR STEAM WISHLIST:[/b]

notes.title: Linux Now Available + Patch Notes!
notes.content:
Dear gang,

We bring you news today!

[h2]Linux Build is now available![/h2]

We're happy to announce that the game is now available on Linux systems. Thank you for waiting! ːirenesmileː

[h2]Patch Notes for v1.0.4.[/h2]

We also updated our [b]Windows[/b] version today to v1.0.4. Here's our patch notes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug wherein volume sliders are always set to 0 in the Options window.
[*] Fixed a bug wherein the Options window doesn't close when changes are applied.
[*] Fixed a bug wherein the game's fps locks to 30 whenever the Texture Quality is set to 540p.
[*] Fixed a bug wherein the game still runs in the background even though its setting is turned off.
[*] Fixed a bug Long chapter titles texts in the Save/Load Game window bleeds out from its text box.
[*] Fixed a bug wherein some texts in the Extras menu are still in English even though the language setting has been changed to another language.
[*] Fixed a bug wherein unlocking multiple achievements at the same time shows the same achievement name.
[*] Fixed a grammatical bug in the German localization, from "XX vor Monaten" to "Vor XX Monaten..."
[*] Updated the Perfect Gold Artbook DLC and fixed numerous text issues.
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1554350/Perfect_Gold__Digital_Artbook/
[h2]Upcoming:[/h2][list]
[*] Fixes for Simplified Chinese language
[*] Mobile Port
[/list]

Thank you so much for your continued patience! We're constantly improving the game for better experience! Please look forward to our next patch! ːmariongrinː

------

notes.title: Steam Festival 2021: Beta Demo
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910603/b31a48a740e0ab5467c8ed8f9f0921f0b3894fdf.png[/img]

Dear gang,

In light of the Steam Festival 2021, we've upgraded Perfect Gold's alpha demo into a beta demo. We've added the following key features to enhance your gameplay experience:
[list]
[*] Full English Voice Acting
[*] Gallery
[*] Localization (Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Russian and German)
[/list]
[h3]What to expect on release[/h3]

Please expect more features to be implemented in the game, such as mouth animation and Steam achievements. In addition, the beta demo's overall quality still has some rough edges; we'll iron those out, so you can expect the game's final version to have a higher level of polish.

Our launch is near, so please don't forget to wishlist the game to get notified when it releases! We'll have a 10% discount on launch week. ːamyhappyː 💛

[h3]Discord Q&A[/h3]

Just like before, we invite all of you to join our live Q&A session over at our Discord server. We'll be online this [b]Monday, February 8th, from 6:00pm-7:00pm (+8 GMT)[/b].

See you soon! (◍•ᴗ•◍)❤
